# Medionary — always-on rules for Copilot

Medionary is a real medical web application (India first, global-ready later). Patients'
health data is involved: security and correctness matter more than speed.

## Brand placeholders (replace once)
- Brand tokens live in: `<LANDING_PAGE_CSS path, e.g. app/globals.css>` and `<TAILWIND_CONFIG path>`
- Frontend app: `<FRONTEND_DIR>`   Backend app: `<BACKEND_DIR>`

## Architecture (most important)
Browser (Next.js) → HTTPS + httpOnly cookie → Express API → Supabase (Auth + Postgres).
- The browser NEVER talks to Supabase or the database. No `@supabase/*` package, Supabase
  URL, anon key or service key in `<FRONTEND_DIR>` (code, env, bundle).
- Express performs every auth flow (email/phone OTP, Google OAuth, MFA, refresh, logout) and
  keeps the session in httpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookies. No tokens in JavaScript or localStorage.
- CORS: exact-origin allow-list with credentials. CSRF protection on cookie-authenticated
  state-changing routes (SameSite + Origin check + required custom header).
- For normal user requests Express uses a Supabase client scoped to THAT user's access token,
  so RLS and column grants still apply. The service-role key is used ONLY in the admin module.

## Stack (do not swap without asking)
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, Zustand, TanStack Query,
  React Hook Form with built-in validation (no Zod).
- Backend: Node + Express + TypeScript, **express-validator** for ALL input validation,
  Redis rate limiting, pino logging.
- Auth + DB: Supabase Auth + Postgres (RLS). Follow CURRENT Supabase/Google docs, not memory.
- Never write custom JWT, password hashing or crypto.

## Database (read-only for you)
`server/db/postgrsql.sql` is the source of truth. Never edit it or change the
schema without asking; propose SQL and wait.
- `profiles` row is auto-created on signup. `user_code` is generated by the DB (`PAT` + 13
  digits + check digit). Show it as `PAT-2858-3971-6856-32`; store without dashes.
- Users may update only `full_name`, `phone_e164`, `handle`, `is_public`.
- Platform admin = `app_metadata.role='admin'`. Doctor/receptionist/hospital-admin rights come
  from DB tables (`doctors`, `hospital_staff`), not from the JWT. NEVER trust `user_metadata`.
- Roles, verification status, doctor codes, hospital staff are written only by the backend
  admin module (service-role).

## Validation (express-validator)
Every route: validation chain + shared `validate` middleware (422, error shape
`{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`). Reject unknown fields; use only
`matchedData(req, { onlyValidData: true })`, never raw `req.body`. Params `isUUID()`.
Phone `^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$`. Handle `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._]{2,29}$` (lowercase first).

## Security (non-negotiable)
1. Service-role key only in backend env and only the admin module imports it. Never logged/committed.
2. Every route: authenticate → authorize → validate → act (user-scoped client) → audit if sensitive. Deny by default.
3. IDOR: changing an ID must never expose someone else's data. Test it.
4. Rate-limit login/OTP/OAuth/MFA (Redis). No user enumeration (identical responses).
5. Never log tokens, OTPs, phone numbers, OAuth `code`/`state`, or full request bodies.
6. Doctors and platform admins MUST have MFA (JWT `aal2`) — also when they sign in with Google.
7. Sensitive admin actions write to `audit_logs` (append-only).
8. helmet, strict CORS, secure cookies, CSRF protection, body-size limits.

## UI
- Never invent colors, fonts or spacing: reuse the tokens from the brand CSS above and map them
  into the shadcn theme variables.
- Mobile-first, accessible, all text i18n-ready (ask before choosing an i18n library), shadcn
  `InputOTP` for OTP, calm non-technical errors, loading/empty/error/success states.

## Working style
- Work on ONE phase at a time (see `docs/auth-phases.md`). STOP at the end of the phase, show
  lint/typecheck/test output, and wait for me to say "continue".
- Ask before adding any dependency. Don't refactor unrelated code.
- Don't claim something works unless a test or command output proves it.
- If anything conflicts with the current docs or the SQL, STOP and ask me.
